[[File:Mark_III_training_droid.png|thumb|right|150px|A Mark III training droid]]
'''Mark III training droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used for [[Training droid/Legends|training]] by elements of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy-conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], the [[Jedi instructor]] [[Liam Dentiri]] used them to test the combat abilities of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="CL3">{{TORcite|type=general|Combat Leadership: Mark III|Tython}}</ref>
